raw.buffDescription: When the Defender is knocked down they gain an Evade charge for 10 seconds. If the Defender is attacked while this charge is active, it is consumed, granting a 100% chance to Passively Evade. The Evade Charge will not be removed if the Defender is struck while Stunned.
